description:
Procureezy is a sovereign AI copilot designed to support engineering and procurement teams in complex industrial environments such as aerospace and space systems.

The platform automatically analyzes technical documentation (datasheets, specifications, BOMs) and transforms unstructured information into structured, actionable data. This enables faster, more reliable engineering and sourcing decisions while reducing manual workload.

By providing a system-level understanding of components and suppliers, Procureezy improves time-to-market, enhances supply chain visibility, and supports more resilient and efficient operations.

The solution is delivered as a secure, API-first SaaS platform compatible with European data sovereignty requirements.

entityDescription:
ZeptoNova is an advanced R&D company specializing in complete, end-to-end solutions for MEMS, microsystems, and advanced electronics. We provide custom device design, low-volume prototyping, and co-pilot fabrication, all the way to mass production through our established network of world-class manufacturing partners. Our mission is to transform breakthrough concepts into manufacturable, scalable products through cutting-edge microfabrication and packaging technologies.

Our Core Competences
MEMS Design & Engineering
- Custom MEMS design and multi-physics simulation
- Feasibility studies and concept validation
- CMOS-MEMS integration (3D packaging, monolithic processing)
Microfabrication Capabilities
- Access to all major academic cleanrooms in Belgium, enabling highly flexible low-volume prototyping
- Single-step microfabrication processes, including:
- Thin-film deposition (CVD, PVD, PLD, ALD)
- Piezoelectric thin films (PZT, AlN, ScAlN)
- Lithography mask production
- Dry etching & deep reactive ion etching (DRIE)
- Other custom micro-processing steps on demand
Fast-Track Production Lines
Ready-to-manufacture product lines for rapid development:
- MEMS Micromirrors
- Inertial Measurement Units (IMU)
- RF MEMS (BAW, SAW)
- PMUT fabrication line
- MEMS Microphone platforms
Advanced Packaging Solutions
We provide industry-grade packaging to bring concepts into robust, product-ready form:
- Wire bonding, flip-chip bonding
- Wafer bonding & vacuum packaging
- Wafer-level packaging
- Post-CMOS chip modification (e.g., ENIG deposition)
- CPC packaging
- Interposer design & fabrication (Silicon or Glass substrates)
Characterization & Testing
Comprehensive lab-grade testing and metrology:
- SEM imaging & surface profilometry
- Laser Doppler Vibrometry
- Electrical & thermal characterization of MEMS devices
- Holographic microscopy
- Thin-film characterization: stress analysis, XRD, reliability testing
- Piezoelectric thin-film characterization (coefficients, stress, permittivity, lifetime)
Ultrasound & Acoustic Solutions
End-to-end ultrasound technology support:
- Interface electronics design
- Transducer packaging
- Underwater acoustic characterization
- Medical imaging consultancy
- Electrical testing & validation
Advanced Electronics
Analog and digital advanced electronics services
- Circuit and printed circuit board (PCB) design
- Embedded software and firmware development
- FPGA programming
- Control systems and communications, Advanced signal processing and AI implementations

description: Inspectiondrone is an innovative startup company that combine drone and AI technologies. We aim to change the today infrastructure inspection methodology which is "obsolete", "dangerous", "low-quality" and "unscheduled". We target the B2B and B2G markets: motorway concession companies, infrastructure management companies, general contractors and mid/big size engineering studios: basically, whoever is managing strategic ageing infrastructures, or want to build a new one. We offer inspection, to evaluate the infrastructure health status now, and how that status will develop in the future. Our service is distinguished by its easiness, quickness and repeatability. Further, it is harmless. Our revenue is generated by “single inspection” to “SaaS portal yearly subscription” streams. Currently, we have a target to grow from € 459k in 2026 up to € 7,5M in 2029.

Solutions Connektica France, founded in 2022 and based in Toulouse, France, develops a specialized AIT (Assembly, Integration and Test) execution platform dedicated to the production of critical space hardware subsystems and components.
The platform integrates Manufacturing Execution System (MES) functionalities with workflow orchestration, real-time data acquisition from test equipment, and process automation into a unified environment. It supports both assembly and testing activities, enabling full digitalization of AIT operations.
Connektica addresses the needs of satellite manufacturers, both legacy and NewSpace players as well as their subcontractors (SMEs), who are facing increasing pressure to scale production while reducing costs and maintaining stringent quality, traceability, and compliance standards (EN9100)
By transforming traditionally engineer-driven AIT processes into operator-executable workflows through digital work instructions and automated procedures, the platform significantly reduces reliance on highly specialized engineering resources. At the same time, automation of test execution and data capture reduces cycle times, minimizes manual intervention, and limits errors and rework.
This approach enables industrialization of space manufacturing by improving production efficiency, ensuring end-to-end traceability, and supporting high-quality standards required for space-grade hardware.

entityName: Universität Wien - Soft Matter Experiments Laboratory (SoMeX)
entityDescription:
The Soft Matter Experiments (SoMeX) Lab investigates the physical principles governing the behavior of soft and biological systems, with an emphasis on both equilibrium and non-equilibrium phenomena. By combining innovative experimental techniques with theoretical insights, the SoMeX Lab addresses challenges ranging from the microscopic dynamics of colloids and foams to the collective behavior of living tissues.

The activities are broadly organized into four main research themes:
1.
Development of novel methods to investigate soft and biological materials
2.
Dynamics of soft matter systems3. Biophysical studies of living matter
4. Non-equilibrium fluctuations and microgravity experiments

entityDescription: The University of Las Palmas de Gran Canaria as such was created in the 1989-1990 academic year, because of a major movement in society in Gran Canaria, which culminated when the Canary Islands Parliament passed the University Reorganisation Law on April 26th, 1989. This law brought together of the Canary Islands Polytechnic University (which was first set up in 1979 as the Polytechnic University of Las Palmas) with other university centres on Gran Canaria, the origins of some of which date back to the 19th century. Research activities reflect the multi-disciplinary nature of our 36 Departments: 12 in engineering and architecture, 11 in science and health sciences, 6 in social and legal sciences and 7 in art and humanities. ULPGC research area is based on 12 Research Institutes, which develop cutting-edge projects in such wide-ranging subjects as telecommunications, microelectronics, computer robotics, marine science, aquaculture, nutrition, cancer, renewable energies, among others.

entityDescription:
Rescomp Engineering is an engineering consultancy specialized in the design, analysis, testing and monitoring of advanced composite structures. The company supports industrial partners throughout the entire development cycle, from early-stage feasibility studies and performance optimisation to detailed structural design and validation.
Rescomp combines strong expertise in simulation and modelling with advanced experimental capabilities, including the design and execution of static and fatigue test campaigns. Experimental results are interpreted through physics-based and data-driven approaches, enabling the development of reliable and efficient design strategies. In parallel, the company provides tailored training and knowledge transfer activities, supporting R&D teams and engineers in areas such as composite design, fatigue assessment and structural health monitoring.
In addition to consultancy and testing services, Rescomp develops proprietary technologies for composite analysis and monitoring. These include advanced tools for fatigue life assessment (FLA), capable of predicting damage initiation, propagation and failure under cyclic loading, and innovative sensorless structural health monitoring (SHM) solutions, which exploit the intrinsic electrical properties of composite materials to detect damage in real time without embedded sensors.
These technologies can be used independently or combined to enable an integrated approach to design and monitoring, supporting the development of safer, lighter and more reliable composite structures, as well as improved prediction of residual strength and service life.
Rescomp is also actively developing new modelling tools targeting emerging applications such as bonded joints and inserts, injection-moulded short-fibre composites, recycled carbon fibre components and additive manufacturing of continuous fibre-reinforced polymers.
